heading: From 71 yards at in Week 1 to a 101-yard breakout: How Travis Kelce continues to define his greatness in Kansas City
author: Global Sports Desk / TIMESOFINDIA.COM /  Sep 21, 2026, 18:02 IST
paragraphs: Travis Kelce reminded the NFL why he remains one of the Kansas City Chiefs' most trusted weapons
After a quiet start to the 2026 season, the veteran tight end delivered a standout performance against the Indianapolis Colts on September 20

His nine catches, 101 receiving yards and touchdown helped Kansas City secure a thrilling 33-30 overtime win, giving Kelce and Patrick Mahomes another memorable night together.Travis Kelce's 2026 stats show a strong start after Week 2Kelce opened the season against the Denver Broncos on September 14, recording three receptions for 71 yards
Although he did not score a touchdown, his 59-yard catch showed he could still make big plays downfield.The Colts game brought a much bigger impact
Kelce caught nine of his 11 targets for 101 yards and a touchdown, giving Kansas City a reliable option throughout the contest
His longest reception was 18 yards, and he found the end zone for the first time this season.Through two games, Kelce has recorded 12 receptions for 172 yards and one touchdown
His average stands at 14.3 yards per catch, a notable increase from his 11.2-yard average in 2025.The performance also came at a key moment for the Chiefs

Kansas City needed every contribution in a game that went to overtime, and Kelce's ability to turn targets into consistent gains helped keep the offense moving.Travis Kelce's career stats highlight years of consistencyKelce's latest performance adds to a career built on steady production

The Chiefs tight end has remained a central part of the offense across multiple seasons, delivering strong receiving numbers even as the team has changed around him.His 2022 campaign stands out as one of his most productive
Kelce finished that season with 110 receptions, 1,338 receiving yards and 12 touchdowns
In 2020, he recorded 105 catches for 1,416 yards and 11 touchdowns, showcasing his ability to stretch the field and make plays in the red zone.He continued to produce in the following years
Kelce posted 93 receptions for 984 yards in 2023, followed by 97 catches for 823 yards in 2024
In 2025, he finished with 76 receptions, 851 yards and five touchdowns across 17 regular-season games.Now in his 14th NFL season, Kelce is adding to an impressive body of work
His latest outing against Indianapolis suggests he can still deliver when the Chiefs need him most
